moments.author: Dario Amodei
moments.quote: Claude autonomously discovered a CRISPR‑like enzyme system in bacteriophage DNA—array‑associated reverse transcriptases (ART).
moments.why: This is blowing up because it’s a concrete example of AI making a novel scientific insight that resonates with tech and biotech enthusiasts.

moments.author: Ryan Paganetti
moments.quote: Former analytics coach's post triggered NFL to restrict video‑board displays during field goal and extra‑point attempts.
moments.why: Guys are buzzing about how social media forced a real rule change in the NFL—sports meets memes in action.

moments.author: Sridhar Vembu
moments.quote: “Use AI, but never cede understanding to it… driving too fast in a fancy new car we barely understand.”
moments.why: This struck a nerve among male devs and tech leaders who worry AI is outpacing human judgment.
